observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black Nikon DSLR camera body with a lens mounted on it, placed on top of its original box.
The box clearly states 'D3300 18-55 VR II Kit' and 'AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II'.
The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D3300' visible on the front and top, respectively.
The lens has 'Nikon DX AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II' printed on the barrel.
The background shows other camera accessories, including a flash unit and another box labeled 'L12d'.
The box also mentions 'VR' and 'BLACK' branding.
The camera body appears to be in used condition with some minor dust and wear visible on the body and lens.

claims.evidence: The sensor size is not visible in the photos. The box does not list the sensor resolution. The seller's text is unverified.
No photo shows the camera's menu or settings screen. The shutter speed and frame rate cannot be confirmed from the images.
The AF points count is not visible in the photos. The seller's text is unverified.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Sensor damage or dust not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the sensor with the lens removed, or a photo of the camera's menu showing sensor health status.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or with sensor issues

risks.risk: Camera not working or shutter failure
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and the shutter count being displayed.

risks.risk: Lens not matching the box or missing accessories
risks.proof: A photo of the lens with the camera body showing the lens attached, and a photo of the lens's rear element to confirm it is the advertised model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly mismatched or missing lens

risks.risk: Camera body has internal damage or water damage
risks.proof: A photo of the camera's serial number and a close-up of the body's internal components (if possible) or a video showing the camera's operation.

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the camera's sensor with the lens removed.
A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and the shutter count being displayed.
A photo of the lens with the camera body showing the lens attached, and a photo of the lens's rear element.
A photo of the camera's serial number and a close-up of the body's internal components if possible.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
